C0553.title: 190-Yuan Frozen Durian Malicious 'Refund-Only' Cross-Province Rights Defense Case
C0553.summary: In April 2026, a buyer purchased 190 yuan of frozen durian meat from merchant Mr. Cheng's online store, ate it, claimed it was spoiled, and applied for a refund-only, which the platform quickly approved. Mr. Cheng deemed it a malicious refund and drove from Henan to Shandong twice for cross-province rights defense, traveling 1,600 km round trip. On May 8 the buyer was administratively detained for 7 days; on May 29 Mr. Cheng filed suit; on June 10, under court mediation, the buyer's family issued a public apology and paid 1,000 yuan in economic compensation.
